purpose: GRID VISION Phase B training-label manifest. IP-clean stack only (Duke-US CC BY, NAIP public domain, OSM ODbL-attributed). Honest scope: transmission towers + substations.

sources.name: ETDII — Electric Transmission Infrastructure Satellite Imagery Dataset for Computer Vision
sources.attribution: Nair, Pathirathna, You, Han, Huang, Yang, Streltsov, Bradbury, Collins, Malof, Hu (Duke Energy Initiative). Imagery: USGS (public domain) / LINZ (CC BY 4.0).
sources.verification: VERIFIED 2026-07-07: figshare API file list + license + Documentation.pdf legend read; US per-class counts tallied by parsing both US zips this session.

nonus_portion.note: only NZ_Dunedin tallied this session (format probe); other NZ cities' per-class counts REPORTED from Documentation, not tallied.

sources.annotation_format: per-image .geojson (WGS84 geom + pixel_coordinates quad) + .csv (per-vertex) + multiclass masks (.npz/.png). Labels: T/OT/L/EN/SS.
sources.fitness: PRIMARY in-scope label set for the first fine-tune. US portion is @0.30 m and license-clean (USGS PD imagery).

sources.name: Duke Electric Transmission and Distribution Infrastructure Imagery Dataset
sources.attribution: Bradbury, Han, Nair, Pathirathna, You et al. (Duke Data+). US imagery USGS/CT-ECO public domain.
sources.verification: VERIFIED 2026-07-07: figshare API file list (16 zips) + license. NOT downloaded (28 GB); per-class counts REPORTED from research/grid_vision_research.md 2.1.
sources.spacetime_caveat: 3 SpaceNet cities (Khartoum/Shanghai/Rio) rest on CC BY-SA imagery — use US zips only for clean license.
sources.fitness: SUPERSET with transmission/distribution split (TT vs DT). Adds 0.15 m US cities beyond ETDII. Pull the US zips (Hartford/Clyde/Wilmington) to grow the US set; downsample 0.15 m -> 0.30/0.60 m to match NAIP GSD.

sources.name: PLAD / STN PLAD
sources.license: GPL-3.0 (REPORTED from grid_vision_research.md 2.4 — the GitHub API was proxy-blocked this session, not re-verified)
sources.verification: EVALUATED + REJECTED. Domain wrong (133 drone close-ups of tower hardware, not nadir satellite) AND copyleft license. Recorded to close the question; NOT a label source.

sources.name: OSM power features (weak labels / corridor seeds)
sources.role: NOT a ground-truth label set. Seeds chip locations (see scripts/gridvision_chips.py) and measures RECALL on corridors (precision needs a human-sampled pass). Weak: tower nodes mapped far less completely than the lines; meters of positional offset; temporal mismatch vs NAIP capture date.

composition_headline.substation_underrepresentation: CONFIRMED: only 6 substation polygons across all 74 US ETDII images vs 1408 towers — substations are ~0.4% of the in-scope US labels. The charter's underrepresentation flag is real; substations need Duke-US zips + OSM-seeded self-bootstrapping to reach a trainable count.
composition_headline.us_naip_domain_note: ETDII US imagery is USGS ortho @0.30 m, not NAIP; treat as US-domain-adjacent and augment with OSM-over-NAIP weak labels for true NAIP radiometry (grid_vision_research.md 2.10).
